tools.description: List individual request logs (model, status, tokens, cost), newest first. Default last 24h, max 30-day span, 90-day age.

from.description: start time RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD (default 24h ago)

to.description: end time RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD (default now)

status.description: filter: settled, failed, pending or all

key_id.description: filter to one API key id

cursor.description: opaque next_cursor from a previous call

tools.name: get_usage_logs

tools.description: Get grouped usage statistics (spend, requests, tokens) over a date range, from the daily summaries.

from.description: start date YYYY-MM-DD (default first of this month)

group_by.description: one or two of: day, month, model, key, api_shape (comma-separated; default day)

api_shape.description: filter to one API shape, e.g. chat_completions

key_id.description: filter to one API key id

tools.name: get_usage_stats
